address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x58`.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

eco2_baseline.docs:
**int**: The eCO2 baseline for calibration purposes. After OTA, this value is used to calibrate the sensor.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

tvoc_baseline.docs:
**int**: The TVOC baseline for calibration purposes. After OTA, this value is used to calibrate the sensor.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

baseline.docs:
The block containing baselines for calibration purposes. See [Calibrating Baseline](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#sgp30-calibrating) for more info.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

humidity_source.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Give an external relative humidity sensor ID here. This can improve the sensor's internal calculations.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

temperature_source.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Give an external temperature sensor ID here. The data must be in Celsius. This can improve the sensor's internal calculations.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

compensation.docs:
The block containing sensors used for compensation. Both values must be supplied in order to be able to generate the absolute humidity to be reported to the sensor.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

eco2.docs:
The information for the CO₂eq. sensor.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

eco2_baseline.docs:
The information for the CO₂eq. baseline value sensor. Baseline value is published in decimals.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

store_baseline.docs:
**boolean**: Store the sensor baselines persistently when calculated or updated. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

tvoc.docs:
The information for the total Volatile Organic Compounds sensor.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

tvoc_baseline.docs:
The information for the TVOC baseline value sensor. Baseline value is published in decimals.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [SGP30 CO₂ and Volatile Organic Compound Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/sgp30#configuration-variables)*
